# Repository Instructions

## Markdown mathematics

For all new or modified Markdown files containing mathematical notation:

- Use `$...$` for inline mathematics.
- Use `$$...$$` for display mathematics.
- Do not use escaped delimiters such as `\\(...\\)` or `\\[...\\]`.
- Keep LaTeX commands inside math delimiters and escape literal Markdown characters when necessary.
- Preserve existing content and formatting unless the task explicitly requests broader edits.

When creating or updating a Markdown study note, automatically convert equation formatting to this convention before committing the file.
